title: Paystride Visa Payroll Card Account: Assessment of ATM, Cash and Foreign Transaction Fees
content:
ATM and foreign transaction fees on the Paystride Visa Payroll Card Account follow the fee schedule of the card plan held on the posted date of the transaction that incurred them. Each fee points to that transaction, carries its ATM network, and posts on the same date. A transaction incurs at most one fee of each fee type.

## Fees by transaction

- **In-network ATM withdrawal:** the plan's in-network ATM withdrawal fee.
- **Domestic out-of-network ATM withdrawal:** the plan's out-of-network ATM withdrawal fee, unless the withdrawal's position in its pay period is within the plan's free out-of-network withdrawals per pay period. Its position is counted among the domestic out-of-network ATM withdrawals posted in its pay period, in order of posted date and then daily sequence, the withdrawal itself included. The free allowance covers only the Paystride fee and never the surcharge the ATM owner adds, which is part of the withdrawal amount.
- **ATM withdrawal outside the United States** (international ATM network): the plan's international ATM fee. It is never free.
- **Teller cash withdrawal at a Visa member bank:** the plan's teller cash withdrawal fee.
- **Balance inquiry at an out-of-network ATM:** the plan's ATM balance inquiry fee, for each inquiry.
- **Withdrawal declined for insufficient funds at an out-of-network ATM:** the plan's ATM decline fee, for each decline. Neither an inquiry nor a decline leaves a debit on the account, so these two fees point to no transaction and are told apart by their daily sequence. Inquiries and declines at in-network ATMs are free.
- **Purchase or withdrawal made in a foreign currency or processed outside the United States:** in addition, a foreign transaction fee of the plan's foreign transaction fee percentage of its amount, rounded to the nearest cent.

## Card pay period

A card pay period runs from one payroll load to the next. It runs from the posted date of the latest payroll load on or before the transaction to the day before the next payroll load. Early wage transfers, instant pay disbursements and off-cycle payroll loads never start a new pay period.

## Limits on assessment

- A fee that comes to zero is not assessed.
- No fee ever takes the balance below zero. A fee larger than the available balance is reduced to the balance, and none is assessed on a zero balance.
- A fee is never assessed on a transaction that was itself an error corrected under Regulation E error resolution.

## Hypothetical worked cases (plan with a free allowance of 2 and an out-of-network fee of 1.95)

| Domestic out-of-network withdrawal in the pay period | Position | Paystride fee |
|---|---|---|
| first | 1 | none |
| second | 2 | none |
| third | 3 | 1.95 |

A foreign purchase of 63.30 on a plan whose foreign transaction fee is 2.5 per cent carries 1.5825, rounded to 1.58.
